The junk armor that became official: WWII crews welded wreck plates onto active tanks, and the idea scaled into the M4A3E2 Jumbo Assault Tank with thicker factory armor. Proof that battlefield improvisation can change policy. Want the full Jumbo vs regular Sherman breakdown next?
